messages:
clare (Marketing): Hey team — quick request: we need a lightweight APAC launch "bento" of assets for a May micro-launch. Goal: social + email + a tiny landing claim panel + an editable inbound-routing SVG for SDRs. Low touch but highly reusable.

Tomas (Design): On it. What counts as the bento? list the exact files you want so I can sketch templates.

clare (Marketing): Bento scope:
- hero GIF (1200x628, short looping, ~2s)
- hero static fallback PNG (1200x628)
- three social microtiles (1080x1080) optimized for copy overlays
- one vertical story (1080x1920)
- email microtiles (600x200) x2 (header + claim sticker)
- claim sticker (760x400) "sticky" PNG + transparent PNG for landing insertion
- inbound_routing_editable.svg (layers: landing, form, score, queues)
- filename + export checklist (txt)
Also need two CTA copy variants for A/B and JP/KR localizations.

Yana (Growth): CTA ideas: Variant A = "See serving savings" Variant B = "Watch cost demo". We'll map A->utm_campaign=may_bento_A, B->utm_campaign=may_bento_B. Also want one short lead magnet microcopy (16-20 chars) for socials.

Tomas (Design): Cool. I'll do two visual directions: "stat-forward" (big % placeholder) and "benefit-forward" (short sentence). For GIF: subtle token-sparkle animation behind the product card. Brands say no gradients — I'll do motion with flat color tokens.

Oliver (Brand): Important: if you include a numeric percentage in the stat-forward variant it must be backed by the benchmark CSV and run date. Otherwise use placeholders like "X% lower per-token cost" or qualitative copy such as "lower per-token cost." Use icon-set v3 and accent-4 for CTA color. Ensure logo clearspace.

legal-bot: Numeric claims require the benchmark CSV upload plus run date for approval. Qualitative claims OK. No competitive naming. No absolutes like "guaranteed savings."

Hana (Localization): I can localize JP/KR if I have source copy by Apr 28. Will need context for short microcopy (tone + max chars). Tagging native reviewers.

clare (Marketing): Deadline: first draft by Apr 26 so we can review Apr 27 and finalize Apr 29 EOD. Social push planned May 3. If localization arrives late we'll overlay text in the exported PSD/SVG.

Tomas (Design): Starter Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz9999/bento-may-launch — frames prefixed "BENTO_MAY". Export notes: GIF from artboard export (1200x628), PNG static fallback, SVG must keep editable layers for routing. I'll include a tiny legend block on the SVG with recommended UTM snippet and ownership.

Tomas (Design): UTM snippet for the legend (exact casing):
```
?utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=may_bento_A
```

Yana (Growth): Also want a tiny example auto-assign rule in the legend: "score>=50 -> AE queue; 20-49 -> Growth nurture; <20 -> nurture drip" so SDRs know triage.

Oliver (Brand): Accessibility check: headings must meet contrast 4.5:1. Motion in the GIF should not exceed 3s loop and should avoid flashing. Use brand motion easing tokens.

Tomas (Design): Timeline: I can post frames Apr 24 (sketches), Apr 26 first pass, iterate Apr 27-28, final export Apr 29 AM. If copy isn't final I can deliver text placeholders.

clare (Marketing): Yana/Hana: please confirm localization and UTM mapping by Apr 25 so design can bake it in.

Yana (Growth): I'll post the UTM mapping sheet today and tag owners. Hana, can you confirm JP/KR turnaround?

Hana (Localization): Yes — I'll turn JP/KR by Apr 28 if source copy locked Apr 25. Tagging reviewers for both locales.

legal-bot: Reminder: if you want to run a numeric A/B (e.g., show ~30% in variant) upload CSV + run date in the legal review thread. We'll fast-track.

clare (Marketing): Great. Tomas, please drop Figma link + an assets checklist when first pass is up. Also include expected filenames and export settings so ops can ingest.

ops-bot: Note: When final assets are uploaded, please attach a CSV of asset filenames + sizes + destination (social/email/landing) for automated deployment.

Tomas (Design): Will do. Figma frames posted and comment thread started. I'll ping when first pass is ready for review. :thumbsup:
